topics.topic: Effect of trial-corpus growth on an existing activation
questions: When a trial case is added, does the existing activation remain current and runnable, become unusable, or cause the active implementation to be admitted again automatically?
When adding or capturing a trial case grows the corpus after an implementation was activated, does that activation remain current and runnable even though its verdict covers an older corpus?

quotes:
Read when a run pins its function nodes. The current activation of a contract
version is the one recorded last; the store has one writer (K-17), so records have
one order.
judgement.why: The change only adds fields to EffectApproval and EffectAttempt and does not touch or make consequential the existing activation rule.

questions: What fact distinguishes a TrialExecution requested by a particular agent from one created automatically as part of admission?
For a trial requested by an agent, which fact identifies that agent and distinguishes it from a TrialExecution created automatically during admission?

quotes:
The owner's actions,
each agent's and the kernel's own are distinguishable in every record.
judgement.why: The change only adds fields to EffectApproval and EffectAttempt and does not alter TrialExecution provenance or make it newly consequential.

topics.topic: Cancellation semantics for a running run with work in progress
questions: What happens when the owner cancels a `running` run while a function execution or service invocation is already in progress, and what NodeExecution or EffectAttempt facts and statuses record that work?
Does `issued_by` name the requesting agent or the kernel that mints the version, and where is the other actor recorded?

topics.topic: Disclosure classification of TrialExecution file outputs
questions: Does each file output recorded by TrialExecution carry a disclosure class, and if so is it stored directly or derived from the trial case inputs?

topics.topic: Final Run status when guarded work is skipped
questions: What final Run status results when all executable work succeeds but one or more nodes or flow outputs are `skipped_by_guard`?
How does a read-only FlowActivation record both the owner or agent who requested it and the kernel that performed the automatic activation?

topics.topic: Recovery lifecycle and statuses for an in-flight effect after restart
questions: On restart, what product action or lifecycle rule converts an EffectAttempt found in `in_flight` into a recoverable run state, and which Run, WaitingPoint and NodeExecution statuses result?

topics.topic: Regrant behavior for an active grant tied to an inactive flow version
questions: If a grant remains active for a flow version that is no longer active and the owner grants that same node again, does the action return the existing grant or refuse because the version is inactive?

topics.topic: Scope of cases executed by the try action
questions: Does the try action execute one named trial case, a caller-selected set of existing cases, or the whole current corpus?

topics.topic: Whether ProofResult identity depends on changing binding context
questions: Is a ProofResult determined by the flow version alone, or is it a contextual result that may change as referenced bindings change status?

topics.topic: Who may supply raw personal data to ingress actions
questions: May an agent supply raw `personal_data` values when running a flow, authoring a trial case, or composing a constant, or must those actions accept such data only from the owner, a service, or an opaque existing reference?
